---
title: "Unicode in output"
jupyter: python3
---

Non-ASCII text in tables and console output. pdflatex (the phu-pdf engine)
knows Latin, Greek and many symbols through the look's fonts; the lab
records what it can't show.

```{python}
import pandas as pd
words = ["Müller", "naïve café", "λ = 0.5", "∑ x²", "→ ←", "½ ± ∞", "Ελληνικά",
         "Ünïcødé", "non\u00a0breaking", "ﬁ ligature"]
pd.DataFrame({"word": words, "len": [len(w) for w in words]})
```

```{python}
for w in words:
    print(w)
```

Scripts and symbols outside the fonts:

```{python}
pd.DataFrame({"word": ["日本語", "😀", "שלום"], "len": [3, 1, 4]})
```
